quests.title: Ascension Challenge IV

dialogue.sit: I'm here for the Ascension Challenge!

dialogue.t: Meow... (Hmm? Here for the Ascension Challenge? I see... You are indeed qualified for the challenge. Alright...)
"I'll have Shuyun set up the challenge for you immediately. Do be careful!"
Meow! (How wonderful! Congratulations on completing the Ascension Challenge. You're now a Legend player!)
Meow... (A Legend player, what an admirable title...)
(I hope you'll keep honing your technique and become a great player who lives up to this grand title!)
(It might be a bit redundant to say this at this point, but still...)
({NICKNAME}, may the fun be with you in the world of Genius Invokation TCG!)
Meow... (How unfortunate... Try to be extra careful next time and perhaps make some adjustments to your deck before your next attempt.)
(I believe you are capable of completing this challenge.)

quests.description: The Genius Invokation TCG Society has determined that you are qualified for the Ascension Challenge. Win the Challenge and become a Legend player! We hope you will have fun with Genius Invokation TCG!
